subject: Initial discovery + demo — Redwood inference / Orion Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery + demo — Redwood inference / Orion Systems

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time to chat last week. Per our conversation, we'd love to do an initial discovery + demo with your engineering and product stakeholders to cover:
- high level architecture and integration options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private)
- security/compliance posture (KMS, audit logs, data isolation)
- performance/cost at your expected QPS and prompt lengths

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 28 Jul, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 29 Jul, 14:00–15:00
- Fri 30 Jul, 09:30–10:30

We usually split this into ~45m technical walkthrough + 15m for ops/procurement questions. I've cc'd our SE, Dylan, who will lead the technical portion. Could you confirm which slot works for Priya (eng lead) and Alan (security)? If procurement wants to join we'll add them to the end of the meeting.

Attached: high-level demo deck to give context.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachment: Redwood_Enterprise_Demo_Deck.pdf (application/pdf, 4.2MB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orion-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@orion-systems.com>, Alan Wu <alan.wu@orion-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery + demo — Redwood inference / Orion Systems

Thanks Marissa —

All sounds good. Priya (eng lead) is available Wed 28 Jul at 10am PT for a 60-minute slot. Alan (security) will try to join but may be on a different call; if he can't make it we'll follow up with a dedicated 30m security sync. Procurement prefers not to join the full technical session but has asked for a 10–15m wrap up to confirm licensing/terms and data handling. Procurement contact is procurement@orion-systems.com — I'll loop them in once we lock the time.

A couple of things for the agenda if possible:
- SSO/IDP support and SCIM provisioning
- KMS/HSM options and key custody
- Retention and audit log capabilities (we'll need SOC2/Security summary)
- Expected latency for 2–5 concurrent streams with ~1k token context

If you can confirm, we'll accept the Wed 28 Jul 10:00 PT slot. Thanks!

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Senior Product Manager, Orion Systems
liam@orion-systems.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery + demo — Redwood inference / Orion Systems

Great — Wed 28 Jul, 10:00–11:00 PT works for us, locking it in. I'll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet in a minute.

Agenda (45m tech / 15m procurement):
1) Intros and goals (5m)
2) Architecture + integration patterns (10m)
3) Demo: latency, throughput, and routing (15m)
4) Security & compliance overview (10m) — Neha will cover KMS, audit logs, and private deployment options
5) Procurement/terms quick Q&A (10m)

Dylan — can you prepare a quick slide on expected performance/cost tradeoffs for a 1k token context at 2–5 concurrent streams and bring a sample prompt set we can run live?
Neha — can you bring the SOC2 summary and top-line notes on KMS and audit logs? I attached a short SOC2 summary for their review.

Pre-demo questionnaire: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-pre-demo-questionnaire — could Priya fill the relevant sections (networking, expected QPS, retention requirements) before the session? That will help us make the session specific.

I'll follow up with the calendar invite and the meeting materials.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Orion Systems demo — agenda & asks

Dylan / Neha — quick internal note to align before Wed's demo.

Dylan:
- 10–15m on architecture and integration options (hosted/dedicated/private) + 15m live demo showing latency/throughput. Please include expected QPS numbers and cost-per-1k-tokens estimates for the scenarios Marissa mentioned.
- Have a short sample prompt set ready (3 prompts) we can run in the session.

Neha:
- 10m security overview: KMS/HSM options, key custody, audit logs, SOC2 scope and evidence locations, VPC/private deployment notes.
- Bring the SOC2-summary.pdf and a 1-pager on data retention and deletion process.

Rishi — FYI, procurement may join the last 10–15 minutes; be ready to answer basic licensing/commit questions or surface to me.

Thanks — please ping if you need anything ahead of time.

-Marissa

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orion-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orion-systems.com>, procurement@orion-systems.com

Thanks everyone — confirmed Wed 28 Jul 10:00–11:00 PT on our side. I've told procurement to hold 10–15 minutes after the technical portion; they'll join if available and otherwise follow up separately.

Priya will fill out the pre-demo questionnaire today. Looking forward to the session — please send the calendar invite and any pre-reads.
